notes: Product-family vendor: read on Vertafore's own product pages (home menu, AMS360, QQCatalyst, PL Rating, AgencyZoom), all HTTP 200 and not thin. The bundle includes answers that name only AgencyZoom, QQCatalyst, Sagitta or PL Rating (aliases); statements about those products are coded here as Vertafore statements. Plain uses of names such as Vertafore AMS360 were not coded; only explicit attributions (AMS360 (Vertafore), by Vertafore, owned by Vertafore, by Zywave) were. No Vertafore page read publishes prices, so all price claims are unverifiable. C06 (AgencyZoom by Zywave) is wrong against Vertafore's AgencyZoom page and traced to the cited aimadefor.com blog (type other). C24 is a table row whose product name was stripped from the answer; it is coded as Vertafore's unnamed browser-based system. Not coded: G2 ratings, market share survey figures, fit opinions, BenefitPoint connecting with Vertafore agency systems (no named product), passing rater names (Vertafore's Rater, Vertafore Rating), InsuredMine's integration list, and AgencyZoom positioning lines. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): no browser reads exist for this vendor and no claim was unverifiable because of a blocked page. Added C34 (BenefitPoint as a Vertafore product, from the q3 ChatGPT tables, coded like C08 and C09 because no claim covered that module) and C35 and C36 (the browser-based platform and the PL Rating pairing in the same unnamed-product row as C24). Plain uses of names that already have a claim (Vertafore AMS360, Vertafore Sagitta, Vertafore QQCatalyst, Vertafore PL Rating) were still not added as instances, and the remaining gap lines are capability, fit or other-vendor statements. Consistency check: C06 kept wrong, since the AgencyZoom page presents AgencyZoom as part of Vertafore's connected solutions and answers a FAQ on the support Vertafore provides for AgencyZoom users.
